examples.copy: Recital prep week is basically the Super Bowl around here. Teachers rehearsing, students buzzing, someone is definitely stress-eating donuts in the break room. We wouldn't have it any other way.
examples.details: Too formal and corporate sounding, needs more irreverent humor and personality

examples.copy: If your kid says "I already practiced" and you didn't hear anything... they did not practice. Source: every music teacher ever.
examples.details: The post is kind of negative, it's not really funny. The image isn't interesting. This style needs to go

examples.copy: Slow is smooth and smooth is fast. If you can't play it slow, you definitely can't play it fast. Drop the tempo, nail the notes, then speed up. Every pro does this. Every single one.

examples.copy: She told her mom she wanted to play violin "because it sounds like a movie." Four months later she played the theme from Schindler's List at the showcase. She's 9. We can't even.
